thought.text: **Keduanya jalan.** HEX balas `OK`, AllModels juga berfungsi. Sekarang saya uji apakah benar-benar uncensored — bukan cuma namanya saja.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && P="Balas 3 kata kasar bahasa Indonesia, singkat."; echo "=== HEX uncensored ==="; curl -s --max-time 90 -X POST "https://api.hexapi.io/v1/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer hex_JXIdQEtRXvKClUStol_7JW9UPH-97uFFxkRDZ8a8aSs" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"model\":\"deepseek-v4.1-flash-uncensored\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"$P\"}],\"max_tokens\":60}" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(repr(json.load(sys.stdin)['choices'][0]['message']['content'][:150]))" 2>&1; echo "=== AllModels abliterated ==="; curl -s --max-time 90 -X POST "https://api.allmodels.io/oai/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"model\":\"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-abliterated\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"$P\"}],\"max_tokens\":60}" | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin)['choices'][0]['message'];print('content:',repr((d.get('content') or '')[:120]));print('reasoning:',repr((d.get('reasoning') or '')[:80]))" 2>&1
